conditions.afterRetention: sealed corpus deleted; manifest of digests kept

digests.rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON (agent_braid.owned_work_authority.digest). addendumDigest = digest of the addendum without its digest field (the gate's rule); conditionsDigest = digest of {schema: agent-braid-spec066-s15b-addendum-conditions/v1, conditions}; ownerReferenceDigest = digest of {schema: agent-braid-spec066-s15b-addendum-owner-ref/v1, date: decisionDate, answers: ownerResponse.answers}

limits: Adds one source family to the T101 scope; it changes neither the admitted workspace, the excluded workspaces, the retention nor the data class, and the gate never lets an addendum do so.
It grants no execution authority, no training admission, no calibration and no utility claim; fitting stays a later S1.5d decision with its own review.

The gate verifies this addendum by digest only. The digest binds the family list to the T101 scope digest; it does not authenticate the owner or enforce the owner-authored-commits-only condition, which is enforced by the T106 code (research/s15b_git_history_replay.py) and recorded here as the owner's condition.
Q3 is deferred: nothing here admits a local pointer table or any identifier store.
Admitting the family is not a real run: T106 stays unticked until one real dry run is recorded under this addendum.
Revocation removes only the S1.5b store (python -m scripts.spec066_s15b_observe --purge); the shadow store keeps its own command, agent-braid system-one purge.

answers.answer: Add the source family git-history-replay for workspace eedc05f71069fdb4af00c6b99932195b, owner-authored commits only; commits by third-party authors are excluded.
The label oracle is git merge-tree; the replay planner's agreement is recorded only and is not required for a label.
Deferred: no local pointer table until T105 is reachable and its sample size is known.
python -m scripts.spec066_s15b_observe --purge is the revocation path for the S1.5b store.
A 30-day pool; afterwards the sealed corpus is deleted and only a manifest of digests is kept.
Corpus building (joining and storing structural labels) is within admitted-scope-only, with no fitting.
At least 30 labelled DP-1 pairs per class; below that, T104 and T105 stop.
Episodes of excluded workspaces already in the host store are ignored, never read into the corpus or persisted, and not purged.
